sources.title: 10-144 CMR chapter 110, Regulations Governing the Licensing and Functioning of Skilled Nursing Facilities and Nursing Facilities — Section 10.Q, Transfer and Discharge Rights (Maine Department of Health and Human Services, Division of Licensing and Certification)
sources.notes: Fixed 2026-09-24, deepening the page to full: the auto-drafted recipe (never actually exercised — every source still carried its draft-recipe.py placeholder note) named extractor html-text/scope body for a .docx URL, which cannot work and errors 'scope selector matched nothing: body' on any real run. The 2026-09-01 change log already states the true transport: retrieved as a .docx file and converted to text with python-docx. Corrected to match. Re-run and diffed against the standing packet after the fix: source 1's text is unchanged (whitespace only), so this is a recipe-definition fix, not new evidence. Sliced 2026-10-08 (FA-Q-20260924-04): from the 10.Q heading plus its first subsection heading (the table of contents prints 'Transfer and Discharge Rights' without the 10.Q. prefix, so the body heading is already unique; the subsection is carried so the anchor cannot land on a table-of-contents row in a future revision) to the 10.R heading, holding section 10.Q entire. The 2026-09-01 hand capture also carried the chapter's title block (six lines, 'Effective August 1, 2020'); a slice is one span, so the title block is no longer in the packet and the effective date is recorded in source_date instead. Every quotation the page draws from this source lies inside 10.Q; verified by check-fidelity.py on both surfaces at the time of slicing.

sources.title: 10-144 CMR chapter 101, MaineCare Benefits Manual, Chapter II, Section 67, Nursing Facility Services — Sections 67.05-9 (Discharges), 67.05-10 (Quality Assurance), 67.05-11 (Prior Approval for Payment of Bed Holds During a Hospitalization), 67.05-12 (Therapeutic Leave of Absence), and 67.05-18 (Right of Appeal) (Maine Department of Health and Human Services)
sources.source_date: page header states "SECTION 67 NURSING FACILITY SERVICES ESTABLISHED 7/1/91" and "LAST UPDATED 9/15/15"; the file's own name carries "LUP 09.15.2014" — both shown as published, not reconciled
sources.notes: Fixed 2026-09-24, same defect and same fix as source 1: extractor corrected from html-text/body to docx/paragraphs-and-tables, matching the true transport the 2026-09-01 change log already documents. Re-run and diffed against the standing packet after the fix: unchanged apart from whitespace. Sliced 2026-10-08 (FA-Q-20260924-04): the hand capture held 67.05-9 through 67.05-12 and 67.05-18, which is not one span, so the slice anchors on the body heading of 67.05-9 (carried with its first subsection heading, because the table of contents prints the bare '67.05-9 Discharges' row first) and runs to the 67.06 REIMBURSEMENT heading, holding 67.05-9 through 67.05-21 entire — a superset of the standing packet, per the CLAUDE.md rule that a slice widens to whole sections and never cuts mid-provision. The chapter title block the hand capture also carried ('SECTION 67 NURSING FACILITY SERVICES ESTABLISHED 7/1/91 / LAST UPDATED 9/15/15') is a running header the document repeats on every page, so it is still inside the slice. Verified by check-fidelity.py on both surfaces at the time of slicing.
